messages.text:
For a floor-standing piece, the Annapolis 20-inch Illuminated Antique Floor Globe is our showcase piece — a large, hand-assembled heirloom globe with a raised relief antique map that glows when lit, set on a handcrafted hardwood stand. It makes a real statement in a study or living room. You'll find it under that exact name in search, ready to add to your cart.

If you'd like something a bit more modern looking, the Statesman 20-inch Illuminated Blue Ocean Floor Globe with Walnut Stand is the floor-standing pick with that classic bright blue-ocean look instead of antique tones.
